peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: BRENTOIL 69.5% with 3/3 replicate support; NATGAS 14.6% with 3/3 replicate support; COPPER 12.5% with 3/3 replicate support; SP500 3.4% with 2/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: Brent crude oil
peers.reason: Brent is the same crude oil exposure and the closest return comparator for WTI, so it carries the dominant peer weight; the main residual is the WTI-Brent basis rather than a different economic driver.

peers.name: Natural gas
peers.reason: Natural gas is the other major energy commodity in the universe. It shares WTI's exposure to global energy demand, heating and power cycles, energy-sector capital spending, and macro growth, and the two often co-move through the broader energy complex, even though gas has more localized supply dynamics.

peers.name: Copper
peers.reason: Copper is the main growth-sensitive industrial commodity. Its returns are driven by global manufacturing and construction demand, the same macro cycle that drives oil consumption, making it a defensible cyclical-commodity comparator rather than a generic risk-on analogy.

peers.name: S&P 500
peers.reason: The S&P 500 is the dominant systematic index and proxies the global growth demand that underpins oil consumption; it is included at a small weight for that demand exposure, while generic risk-on co-movement is handled by the primary hedge rather than used to justify peers.

primary_index_hedge.name: Brent crude oil
primary_index_hedge.reason: Brent crude oil is the direct global substitute for WTI: both are benchmark light crude oil futures whose returns are driven by the same global oil supply-demand balance, OPEC policy, inventories, and geopolitical risk. Shorting Brent against a long WTI position hedges nearly all crude price risk, leaving only the regional WTI-Brent basis spread. It is also highly liquid at 73.627 USD millions of 24-hour perp liquidity, close to CL's own 102.282 USD millions, so the hedge is executable at scale.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
